terms.comment: Our description of the Portuguese pastéis de nata, little pastries filled with cream. Traupman has no word for them, and Morgan–Owens only oeogala, its own formation from Greek, for custard (s.v. pudding: custard).

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. pudding: custard.
